name: her_voice
for: Mother of the Black Water: her voice
notes: A wet pale-green sound front 81 px tall carrying three small wailing drowned faces (the faces on her back, same pixel density) whose mouths open and close, each trailing a wavering ectoplasm tail; one echo, wisps streaming back, water dripping off the front and ringing on the floor, bubbles of drowned breath, a wash at its foot. Chest-high: roll through it. Distinct from the keen: drowned faces and water, not clean violet crescents. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 85; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 58; place that point on the ring's position.
